room_rent.note: Upgradeable to Any Room via Enhance Plus / Enhance / Freedom optional packages. Assure package limits to 1% of SI/day.

icu.note: ICU covered up to Sum Insured opted. Assure package limits to 2% of SI/day.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base plan. Zone-based co-pay applies if treatment taken in higher zone: Zone II insured in Zone I = 10%; Zone III insured in Zone II = 10%, in Zone I = 20%. Insured can opt Zone I premium to avoid this.

sub_limits.display: No sub-limits (base); Assure package adds sub-limits
sub_limits.note: Base plan has no disease sub-limits. Optional Assure package (Protect plan, SI ≤₹5L) caps: Hernia/Hysterectomy/BPH/Stones ₹50k–₹65k, Cataract ₹20k–₹30k/eye, Knee replacement ₹80k–₹1L/knee, Bone fracture ₹2L–₹2.5L. Modern treatments capped at 50% SI for SI <₹5L (base plan).

deductible.note: No inbuilt deductible. Optional deductible of ₹10,000 or ₹25,000 on aggregate per policy year available. ₹25,000 deductible locked for 4 years once opted.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months for Sum Insured ₹7.5L and above; 36 months for Sum Insured below ₹7.5L. Reducible via portability credits.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions include cataract, hernia, knee replacement, varicose veins, stones, BPH, hydrocele, fissure/fistula/piles, CSOM, sinusitis, tonsils, gastric ulcer, cysts/polyps, etc.

maternity.note: Covered under Enhance Plus (Protect) or Enhance (Advantage) optional packages. Up to 10% of SI subject to max ₹1L per delivery; max 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime. Waiting period 36 months. Includes newborn cover and first-year vaccinations.

cumulative_bonus.note: 25% of SI added per claim-free policy year; max 200% of SI. Optional Cumulative Bonus Booster (50%/yr, max 200%) replaces base CB. ManipalCigna Prime Plus add-on offers Supreme Bonus of 100%/yr up to 800% of base SI.

restoration.note: 100% SI restored unlimited times per policy year for same or unrelated illnesses, once base SI + CB is exhausted. Not available for first claim in the year. Not applicable for Bariatric Surgery, Air Ambulance, OPD, Daily Cash, Maternity, Infertility, Health Check-up.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered up to 60 days before admission, up to Sum Insured.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered up to 180 days after discharge, up to Sum Insured.

day_care.note: All medically necessary day-care procedures covered up to Sum Insured.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered up to 10% of Sum Insured; minimum 3 days treatment required. Pre/post-hospitalisation up to 30 days each. Restoration not available.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient and day-care treatment covered up to Sum Insured. Excludes pleasure/rejuvenation treatments like Panchakarma.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered; complications up to 30 days post-discharge covered up to 25% of SI subject to max ₹2L, over and above Sum Insured. Donor screening covered once per year for successful transplant.

ambulance.display: Up to SI (road); Air ambulance up to ₹10L over SI
ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to Sum Insured. Air ambulance covered up to SI subject to max ₹10L, over and above Sum Insured, for life-threatening emergencies within India.

modern_treatments.display: Covered (up to SI for SI ≥₹5L; 50% SI for SI <₹5L)
modern_treatments.note: Listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered. For SI <₹5L: up to 50% of SI. For SI ≥₹5L: up to SI. Assure package caps at 10% of SI.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items (Annexure III List I) covered as optional cover D.IV.1. Reduces Sum Insured when claimed.

global_cover.note: Worldwide Emergency Hospitalisation with Outpatient Cover available under Freedom optional package for Indian residents. Covers emergency in-patient and OPD outside India up to Sum Insured, over and above SI. Claims settled in Indian rupees.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium modes; 15 days for monthly instalment mode. Coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in instalments.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period on new policies only (not on renewals or portability). Refund of premium less proportionate risk premium and medical examination/stamp duty costs.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: Multifocal/femto-laser cataract lenses, CPAP/CAPD devices, external congenital anomaly, non-allopathic (non-AYUSH) treatments, circumcision (non-medical), sleep apnea instruments

optional_riders.display: Enhance Plus/Enhance (maternity+room upgrade+HMB), Freedom (worldwide emergency), Assure (sub-limits+1%SI room), Non-Medical Items, Deductible, Infertility, Personal Accident, CB Booster, Critical Illness Add-on, ManipalCigna Prime Plus
